required: failure must not be represented as success
failure must become perceptible when it affects the user
last valid state or content must be preserved when technically and semantically possible
a recovery action or degraded continuation must be offered or executed when safely available
recovery must not create product authority or silently approve content
forbidden: requiring a framework-specific ErrorBoundary across products
discarding valid user content merely because a later operation failed
silent failure after a consequential action

promotionRule: QUALIFIED is permitted only after immutable evidence receipts, fail-closed validation and independent exact-head review all PASS. STABLE remains forbidden in Stage A.2. Runtime adoption requires separately governed Stage B.
